actions.label: List Books
actions.description: See the books in your Gatefold library.
actions.agent: Lists the books in the library with their title, author and whether each is on this device. Changes nothing.

query.label: Search
query.description: Words to match against titles and authors; leave it out to list everything.

books.label: Books
books.description: One line per book: its title, two spaces, then its id. Empty when none match.

actions.label: Open Book
actions.description: Open a book in Gatefold at the place you left it.
actions.agent: Opens a book from the library in Gatefold, at the reading place kept for it, so the person sees it. Changes no text. Fails when the book is not on this device.

book.label: Book
book.description: The book: its title as list_books shows it, or its id.

actions.label: Sync Reading Place
actions.description: Send your reading place to your other devices now.
actions.agent: Sends the reading place of every book whose place is still waiting to be sent, now rather than later. Returns when the sending finishes.
